subtitulos.texto: 100%plant-based ham croquettes, crispy, creamy, and super tasty. But if you don't eat meat, why do you insist on making recipes with ingredients that simulate it? Well, look, vegans didn't become vegan because we stopped liking certain flavors. We became vegan for ethical reasons. Therefore, if we want to keep enjoying the flavors we've always loved, but without animal cruelty, what’s the problem? Often it’s just a matter of replacing the animal-based ham with plant-based ham. Only the ingredient changes, not the tradition, because food is also memory, after-dinner conversations, it's childhood. Being vegan doesn't mean having to give up those memories; it's just a matter of reinventing them. The problem was never the croquette, it was what was behind it. If we can enjoy our usual croquettes, but with a clear conscience, why not do it? Look how great they look. Yeah.
